notes.subject: על מות
notes.rationale: KJV/ASV 'inap long dai'; YLT 'antap long dai' (Yahwe i winim dai); JPS 'oltaim' — i no gat dai.

notes.subject: עולם
notes.rationale: As bilong tok em i 'samting i stap hait' — taim ol man i no ken lukim; Tok Pisin i holim piksa bilong hait.

notes.subject: עולם
notes.rationale: Tok i tokim taim i hait long man — samting i lukluk i no ken Lukim.

translation: Bilong dispela: em i Elohim, Elohim bilong yumi, long taim we i lukluk i no ken lukim, na oltaim i no gat pinis; em bai i bringim yumi go inap long taim bilong dai.
